scripts.prepare: npm run build --workspace @hasarbotu/domain && npm run build --workspace @hasarbotu/contracts
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run build --workspace @hasarbotu/domain && npm run build --workspace @hasarbotu/contracts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty false && npm run typecheck --workspace @hasarbotu/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace @hasarbotu/contracts
scripts.test: vitest run src && npm run test --workspace @hasarbotu/domain && npm run test --workspace @hasarbotu/contracts
